results.title: Simulation step cost
results.evidence: 3600 steps (60 s of match time) in 54 ms of CPU: 0.015 ms per step on the verification machine.

results.title: Frame rate on GPU hardware
results.evidence: Manual demonstration: play a 5-minute match on a computer with a hardware GPU and watch the browser's frame-rate meter (Chrome DevTools > Rendering > Frame rendering stats). Not run here: the headless verification machine has no GPU, so software-rendered frame rates would not be meaningful.

results.title: Simulated computer-vs-computer matches
results.evidence: 10 matches of 5 minutes, both teams computer-controlled. Shots 114, goals 19: conversion 16.7% (1.9 goals per match). Ground passes received 550/685 (80.3%). Lofted passes received 483/663 (72.9%). Per match: sliding tackles 4.7, offsides 0.3, fouls 2.8, yellow cards 1.2, red cards 0.10.

results.title: Scripted-user pass completion
results.evidence: 6 matches of 5 minutes as Harbor City. The scripted user dribbles toward goal, passes with J every 0.7–1.7 s and keeps holding the forward key for 0.5 s after each pass. User ground passes received 96/111 (86.5%); 3 lost by the receiver within 1.5 of the ball, the rest intercepted on the way.

results.title: No script errors across the whole run
results.evidence: 0 uncaught errors or console errors (other than blocked web-font requests) were recorded across every page and match in this run, including 16 complete 5-minute matches, several 3-minute matches and the career-mode cases.

results.evidence: Squad of 18: attributes 15–99, overall = position-weighted sum, potential ≥ overall, names, ages and numbers present: true; shirt numbers unique true. Rated 90 v 50 for pace, run speed 7.31 v 6.21 m/s. Passing 95 v 40: mean sideways miss over 25 m 0.12 v 0.64 m. Shooting 95 v 40: share of shots from 20 m on target 0.89 v 0.72. Defending 95 v 35 against a 70 dribbler: standing tackles won 0.87 v 0.57. Goalkeeping 95 v 40: shots saved or parried 0.95 v 0.65. Stamina 95 v 40: stamina used in 5 s of sprinting 0.019 v 0.030.

results.title: Formation and line-up
results.evidence: Choosing 4-3-3 re-picked the eleven with a goalkeeper in slot 1: true; slots shown GK,LB,CB,CB,RB,CM,DM,CM,LW,ST,RW. Tapping a forward highlighted the row true; tapping a substitute defender swapped them true and saved it true. The defender in a forward slot shows his rating −8 in red true (keeper in an outfield slot −35). In the 3D match that player's attributes are scaled by 0.9 in the forward role true. Auto-pick put a forward back in the slot true.

results.title: Transfer market
results.evidence: Market lists 19 players, priced by rating and age true. With 0 coins every paid player's Buy is disabled true. Buying the first player for 355 coins took the coins and added him to the squad and line-up true. At 25 players Buy is disabled true. Selling returned 60% of value (75 coins) and removed him true. At 16 players every Sell is disabled and the eleven is still complete true. After one match the market had new players true.

results.title: Player development, ageing and youth
results.evidence: Across 12 simulated matches, 4 starters improved their overall rating. At the end of the season every remaining player is a year older true; three 20-year-olds with room to grow all improved true; three 32-year-olds all declined true; 2 of five 36-year-olds retired; 2 17-year-old youth players joined, leaving 18 players. The season report lists the retirements and youth players true, and the new line-up is complete with a keeper in goal true.

results.title: Stadium expansion
results.evidence: With 1,000 coins the 1,200-coin upgrade is disabled true. With 1,300 coins, expanding took the stadium to level 2 (6000 seats, shown true) and left 100 coins. Capacities 2000/6000/14000/28000/48000; costs 1200/3500/9000/20000. Stands visible by level as [end stands, main roof, end roofs]: 000 · 100 · 110 · 111 · 111. Matches use the home club's stadium (VC-38).

results.title: Through balls
results.evidence: 20 trials: I played 20 passes, 20 flagged as through balls to the runner; 20 sent into space at least 2 ahead of him; 20 reached him. Computer teams played 30 through balls in 10 simulated matches (3.0 per match).

results.title: Skill moves
results.evidence: A defender kept on the ball for 0.35 s took it 29 times in 80 trials without a skill move and 0 times in 76 trials where the move started (4 did not start because control had not passed to the dribbler). Pressing O started a 0.38 s move with a 1.28 s cooldown, cost 0.030 stamina and carried the player 2.3 with the ball (still his: true); pressing again at once did nothing true. Computer dribblers made 106 skill moves in 10 matches (10.6 per match).

results.title: Stamina
results.evidence: 5 s of sprinting used 0.024 stamina; 5 s of running 0.015. Standing still for 5 s recovered 0.006. Running speed at 20% stamina is 89% of a fresh player's. Half time took every player from 0.50 to at least 0.65. Average outfield stamina at full time over 10 simulated matches: 0.68.

results.title: Substitutions
results.evidence: Pause menu shows Substitutions true; it opens the panel true. Swapping a tired player for the first substitute put the new player on with full stamina true; 1 used, 4 left on the bench; announced "HAR SUBSTITUTION · ON M. Holm · OFF Z. Bonnet". After 5 substitutions every button is disabled true. Done returns to the pause menu true; in Watch mode the button is hidden true. Computer teams made 31 substitutions in 10 matches, at most 3 per team per match, the earliest at 61.6'.
